intro.text: 11:58 pm. The quarterly report is still running.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Nobody reads these dashboards anyway. SQL is just... busywork.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I'll just close my eyes... until it reaches 100%...
The progress bar stops at 99%. So does Ada's heart.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Grass? Why is the sky a table? Why does it have so many columns?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Welcome to the Kingdom of Codd, witch. Here the world is a database, and magic is querying.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Your Grimoire. Here, magic is not waved: it is written. Every spell is a query.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I write SQL all day. How hard can it be?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Then show me. Before you meet anything with teeth, practice on something made of straw.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: My right page holds only four rows. You pay for every spell you summon, but only the rows you can read take effect.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Never written a query? In battle, press F3 or click GUIDE: I will show you what to write, and how to read my pages.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: And you will learn the rest from the first thing that wants to eat you.
Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: the ASTERISK SLIME!

battle_tip: New to SQL? Press F3 for the spell guide.
victory: The Asterisk Slime melts into a puddle of rows.
Ada: One word. LIMIT. And the page behaves.
defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Slime wobbles triumphantly.
Grimoire: Even the best witches overflow sometimes. Again?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: LIMIT is yours, witch. The next guardian is not beaten with fewer spells, but with the right ones.
The Filter Keep. Its gate opens only for what is relevant.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Halt! I am Sir Wherewell, Knight of the Filter. My Ward of Relevance stops every spell that does not matter.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Only a spell of the element I am weak to can get through. Do you know which one, witch?

knight_intro.speaker: Ada
knight_intro.text: I know dozens of spells now. How do I cast only the right ones?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: Look at him first with SELECT * FROM enemies and find his weakness. Then watch his book: he never casts without WHERE.

knight_victory: Sir Wherewell kneels and opens the gate.
Ada: WHERE. Ask only for what you need.
knight_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Knight lowers his blade.
Grimoire: Spells that are not super-effective bounce off. Filter for his weakness.
end_of_slice: End of the vertical slice. Thank you for playing!

count_intro.speaker: Grimoire
count_intro.text: Your runes grow, witch. You can ask for exactly what you need. But what if there are far too many of them?
The Tally Barracks. Bats hang from every rafter in neat rows, and something counts them.

count_intro.speaker: Count Aggregor
count_intro.text: Good evening. I am Count Aggregor, and I count everything. One witch. Twelve bats. Zero chances.

count_intro.speaker: Count Aggregor
count_intro.text: While any squad of mine has three or more bats, the quorum holds and nothing you cast can touch me.

count_intro.speaker: Ada
count_intro.text: Twelve bats, a four-row page... if I aim one spell at every bat, I overflow before I start.

count_intro.speaker: Grimoire
count_intro.text: Then do not count bats. Count squads. Watch his book: he never casts without GROUP BY, and his HAVING tells you when he is safe.

count_victory: Count Aggregor's abacus cracks. The tally is final.
Ada: GROUP BY. One row per squad, not per bat.
count_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The bats settle back on the rafters.
Grimoire: Too many rows. GROUP BY e.squad: one spell per squad.

null_intro.speaker: Grimoire
null_intro.text: You can count now, witch. The last guardian cannot be counted. It cannot even be compared.
The Null Void. No floor, no sky, no values. Only a shape that looks a lot like you.

null_intro.speaker: NULL
null_intro.text: Hello, Ada. I am the voice that said your queries were pointless. I have been watching you since the Glade.

null_intro.speaker: NULL
null_intro.text: My hp is NULL. My element is NULL. Your = cannot find me, and your hp > 0 filters me out.

null_intro.speaker: Ada
null_intro.text: Then I cannot even aim at it. How do I hit something that has no value?

null_intro.speaker: Grimoire
null_intro.text: Look straight at the void: IS NULL, COALESCE. And it learns how you cast. Never cast the same way twice.

null_victory: NULL flickers, and for once it has a value: zero.
Ada: My queries were never pointless. Precision is power.
null_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. NULL wears her silhouette a little better.
Grimoire: = never matches NULL. Use IS NULL, and vary your casts.
count_tip: Name a squad in your row to aim at it. F3: guide
null_tip: Spells pass through NULL. Look: IS NULL. F3: guide
